metadata.datasource: Kodak publication F-4016 (June 2018), vector paths of p8 (spectral sensitivity; D-76 small-tank characteristic curves).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 400-700 nm (the 0.3-above-D-min curve of p8), ASSUMED held below 400 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0354 dex/nm above 700 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -2.04..1.74 (D-76 small tank, daylight, 6.18 min = CI 0.56, interpolated between the plotted curves); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.601 into a ceiling of gross D 3.2 above (the highest density the sheet plots)
tags.log_exposure_anchor: SHEET ISO 100 + LIT: 0 = log10(0.8/100)+1.0 = -1.097 log lux-s
tags.base_density: SHEET level 0.209 (base+fog at CI 0.56), ASSUMED spectrally flat
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0088 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
